as_told.title: Hillary Clinton's planned UFO answer on Kimmel goes unasked

plain: A researcher, Grant Cameron, describes the Podesta emails, private emails of John Podesta, a political adviser to Hillary Clinton, that later became public. Cameron says they mention a "seven-year plan" to promote the UFO subject, and that Podesta wanted Clinton to be asked about aliens when she appeared on the late-night TV show of host Jimmy Kimmel, which in one telling he dates to November 2015. According to Cameron, Kimmel never asked the UFO question and Clinton was furious, which he tells as a sign that people at the top of US politics meant to talk openly about UFOs.
